title: CatalogEntry
description: A searchable index record for a governed object, release, or artifact family without redefining the canonical object itself.

specVersion.description: Spec version of this document, e.g. "2.0.0".

objectRef.description: Reference to the canonical object represented by this catalog entry.

objectType.description: Type name of the canonical object, such as ReleaseManifest or EvidenceBundle.

title.description: Optional title for indexing and presentation.

labels.description: Index labels, tags, or dimensions used for discovery.

evidenceBundleRef.description: Optional EvidenceBundle ref associated with the indexed object.

authorityRef.description: Optional ref to the authority or namespace governing this entry.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 date-time when this catalog entry was last updated.

scope.description: Ownership/visibility scope of the catalogued object. Docs/datasets/collections are auto-catalogued at user/project/chat scope (private to their owner's catalogue view); only 'platform' is estate-wide. Promotion to 'platform' is NOT automatic — it requires an approved DataAcquisitionRequest (see `promotion`). Optional for backward compatibility; when absent, a legacy index record is treated as 'platform'.

ownerRef.description: URN of the user/project/chat that owns this entry at its scope (urn:srcos:user:… / urn:srcos:project:… / urn:srcos:chat:…). Drives the per-owner catalogue view.

promotion.description: Promotion lifecycle toward platform scope. INVARIANT (enforced by validate_data_acquisition_examples.py): scope=='platform' requires promotion.state=='promoted' AND a darRef — a catalogued object cannot reach platform scope without an approved Data Acquisition Request.

state.description: origin = private to its scope; requested/under-review = a DAR is in flight; approved/denied = DAR decided; promoted = now at platform scope.

darRef.description: URN of the DataAcquisitionRequest that authorized promotion. Required (non-null) once state is 'promoted'.
